Syllabus inventory

Chapter weightage and shifts asked are taken from your priority list. Topic badges are rank bands: top 20% of ranked topics = high, next 30% = medium, remaining = core list. They are relative priority indicators, not topic-wise probability or guaranteed marks. Historical weightage is a guide, not a prediction.

Resilience

Bad mock? Review it, then come back harder.

A low score is data, not a verdict. Log it honestly, find the two or three chapters that cost you marks, and fix those first.

Revision

The loop that turns a covered chapter into retained marks.

Suggested loop: learn → solve selected examples → PYQs → revise after a gap → timed test. Log only what you actually complete.
